messages:
anya: heads-up — customer 'Glyph' is hitting intermittent 502s (and a couple 504s) on hosted-api streaming endpoints. Happens during long-lived streams (~30-90s). They reported ~8 failures in the last hour. trace id from customer: tr_4c1b9a; req id: req-20240207-9f2b

mike: ack. can you paste any sample trace/req ids + whether streaming or single-shot? assigning oncall (mike) to triage :rotating_light:

anya: sample from customer: trace=tr_4c1b9a req=req-20240207-9f2b. It's streaming (client sends keepalive pings occasionally, but long idle gaps between tokens). They say it often fails mid-stream with a 502 + no body.

jordan: grabbing logs from midproxy and envoys now. quick note: upstream returned RST_STREAM + connection reset before response in a few entries.

jordan: log snippet from midproxy (truncated):
```
[2024-02-07T14:02:11.123Z] "POST /v1/streams HTTP/2" 502 UA=envoy upstream_reset_before_response: connection terminated (errno=104) trace=tr_4c1b9a req=req-20240207-9f2b
[2024-02-07T14:02:11.124Z] upstream: "10.4.12.7:8443" error: recv() failed: Connection reset by peer
```

kai: initial hunch: midproxy idle/stream timeouts are shorter than some client idle gaps. If upstream closes idle conn or GOAWAY is sent, envoy may surface 502s for active streams. Also seen keepalive/connection pool exhaustion in similar incidents.

lena: checked auth/billing headers for that trace — Authorization header present and billing-account header looks normal. No 401/403. Not a billing injector issue.

anya: repro steps provided to customer to help us:
```
# simple HTTP/2 streaming repro (curl)
curl -v --http2 -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams
# let it sit ~45s between inputs, repeat
```
Please run from their network to reproduce. They already did and saw 502 after an idle gap.

mike: thanks. short mitigation we can try immediately: bump midproxy upstream idle_timeout from 30s -> 120s for the customer-serving pool, and temporarily increase keepalive pool size on midproxy. I'll schedule a targeted rollout to 2/3 nodes to see effect.

ops-bot: deploy planned by mike: midproxy/upstream idle_timeout bump -> rolling config apply to pool "midproxy-customer-01" starting 2024-02-07T14:12:00Z

jordan: after the config roll to two nodes, we saw a drop in 502s for that trace (same customer) in the next 20m window. midproxy logs show fewer upstream resets.

mike: follow-up tasks: 1) validate h2 keepalive settings across midproxy and upstream inference hosts; 2) add metric alert for upstream_reset_before_response spikes; 3) create an action item to review GOAWAY handling in the runtime (ENG-RUNTIME).

anya: created support ticket SR-54823, noted customer repro and mitigation steps. tagging ENG-SRE and ENG-RUNTIME.

lena: customer confirmed on call: after our temporary change they had 0 502s for ~35 minutes during the same test. They are unblocked for now but want root-cause doc.

jordan: preliminary root cause: short idle timeout on midproxy + client idle gaps during streaming caused upstream connections to be closed and Envoy surfaced 502s for in-flight streams. likely exacerbated by small keepalive pool under burst.

mike: marking as resolved from support side; will follow with postmortem + permanent config and a small runtime change request. I'll open JIRA INF-3412 and assign to ENG-RUNTIME and ENG-SRE.

anya: thanks everyone, closing this thread for now. adding notes to SR-54823 and will update customer with postmortem ETA. :white_check_mark:
